description: Save a new recipe to the household's own recipes. Mark what can be made ahead (a sauce, a dough) in timeline, so it lands on the prep day.

equipment.description: What the kitchen needs that is not food. Never on the shopping list. On edit_recipe the list replaces it.

functionTags.description: Allergen groups and roles used by the safety checks.

isOptional.description: True when the dish works without it.

note.description: What the recipe says about the line beyond the amount, e.g. '17–19 g per kilo'; omit when there is none.

quantity.description: Amount for the recipe's portion count.

section.description: The part of the dish this line belongs to (Kakebunn, Glasur); omit for a recipe without parts.

unit.description: Unit, e.g. 'g', 'dl', 'pcs'; empty string if unitless.

note.description: The recipe's own note: the intro and the author's assessment. On edit_recipe an empty string removes it.

ovenSettings.description: The oven per step. On edit_recipe the list replaces all of them.

portions.description: How many portions the base quantities make.

stepNotes.description: Notes under the steps. On edit_recipe the list replaces all of them.

text.description: The note as the recipe writes it under the step.

timeline.description: The steps done at a set time before serving, and the ones that can be made ahead. Mark what can be made ahead whenever the recipe or the user says so («sausen kan lages dagen før»); a step that must happen at cooking time has no entry, and most recipes have few. On edit_recipe the list replaces the whole timeline.

durationMinutes.description: How long the step takes, when the recipe says.

earliestFrozenMinutesBefore.description: Set too when the part freezes well: how early when frozen, e.g. a base sauce 43200 (30 days). Must be more than earliestMinutesBefore. Leave out when it should not be frozen.

earliestMinutesBefore.description: Set when the step can be done ahead and keep in the fridge — a sauce, a dough, cut vegetables. This is what puts it on the household's prep day. How early, in minutes before serving: a sauce made the day before 1440, two days 2880. Must be more than minutesBefore. Leave out for a step that must be done at minutesBefore.

label.description: A short imperative, e.g. 'Salt the ribs'.

minutesBefore.description: How long before serving the step starts, counted back: a marinade 720, a dough rising 90, salting the ribs three days ahead 4200. For an evening step that may also be made ahead, the recipe's total time.

thawMinutes.description: How long the frozen part takes to thaw, e.g. 720. Only with earliestFrozenMinutesBefore.

totalMinutes.description: Total minutes from start to serving (≥ active).

name: save_recipe
title: Save a recipe
